findings.title: Org stdio entry named like a bundled default is shadowed
findings.problem: mergeWithBundled applies the backend-wins merge only to installable org entries; non-installable entries are appended after the bundled defaults. A stdio org entry named Notion is listed next to bundled Notion, and findCatalogEntry (first match) resolves the bundled http entry, so 'mcp install notion' registers the bundled URL instead of refusing the org entry. Tests cover only an http collision and a uniquely named stdio entry.
findings.impact: The listing shows two entries with one name, and install registers a URL the org did not publish for that name; the backend-wins claim in the doc comment and docs does not hold for this case. Reachability depends on the org publishing such an entry: uncertain, capped at major.
findings.recommendation: Apply the collision rule to every backend entry (displace bundled defaults on name or endpoint collision regardless of transport), or refuse the name as ambiguous; add a catalog.test.ts case for a stdio entry named like a bundled default.

findings.title: Shared Desktop/mcp fallback not extracted
findings.problem: The spec requires the merge and fallback logic to be shared by Desktop and mcp. Only the merge moved to managed-mcp-catalog.ts. bundledOnly in catalog.ts re-implements the bundled fallback, while desktop.ts (around line 697) keeps its own seeding of DEFAULT_MANAGED_MCP_SERVERS.
findings.impact: A required spec behavior is only partly delivered; the two fallbacks can drift apart, and the Desktop-unchanged guarantee is harder to keep.
findings.recommendation: Move the fallback seeding into managed-mcp-catalog.ts and have both desktop.ts and catalog.ts call it, keeping Desktop output identical; or record the divergence as an accepted deviation in the spec.

findings.title: Install uses a duplicate proxy precondition check
findings.problem: The spec says install keeps the preconditions as today, ensureProxyCommandExists(). installCatalogServer calls ensureInstallProxy, which repeats the getCommandPath('codemie-mcp-proxy') check and throws ToolExecutionError. The existing ensureProxyCommandExists helper at index.ts:11 is never called by install.
findings.impact: Two copies of one precondition can drift, and the spec names a single helper. Behavior is the same; only the error type differs.
findings.recommendation: Call ensureProxyCommandExists from installCatalogServer and map its failure to the install error, or align ensureInstallProxy with the shared helper so there is one check.

findings.title: Org-supplied name and URL reach a Windows shell command line
findings.problem: resolveAgentCommand sets shell: true on win32 for codex and gemini (resolveClaudeCommand does the same for claude). installCatalogServer passes the org-supplied catalog name and url into buildAddArgs, and exec.ts joins them into one command string with double-quote escaping only; cmd.exe does not honor the backslash escape, so a name with an embedded quote followed by & can end the quoted span. The name is not validated against an allowlist; the leading-dash check runs only on raw user input.
findings.impact: On Windows, a crafted org catalog entry could run extra commands when a user installs it. Reachability requires a crafted backend entry, not verified in-tree: uncertain, capped at major. Security risk flag set.
findings.recommendation: Validate the catalog name against an allowlist (e.g. ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$) and the url through new URL() with http/https only before any exec; alternatively, avoid shell: true by invoking the resolved binary directly.

findings.title: desktop.ts exceeds the 500-line file limit
findings.problem: desktop.ts is 807 lines after this change (937 at base). code-quality.md caps files at 500 lines, and the change touches the file without bringing it under the limit. The violation predates this change, but the intent does not exclude it, so it cannot be deferred.
findings.impact: A blocking documented code-quality standard stays violated in a file this change touches.
findings.recommendation: Move cohesive groups (for example model selection, reconcileManagedMcpServers, config writing) into sibling modules until desktop.ts is under 500 lines.
